debussy_fine_violet_ink.name: debussy_fine_violet_ink
debussy_fine_violet_ink.description: Fastidious Parisian fair copy in blue-violet/sepia-tinted ink with tiny calligraphic noteheads on dense 24-staff pre-ruled French paper.
debussy_fine_violet_ink.paleography_notes: Modeled on Claude Debussy's meticulous fair-copy scores (e.g., La Mer, Douze Etudes) on pre-ruled Parisian papier a musique (Lard, Durand, Litolff). Features a fine dip nib in blue-violet/sepia-tinted ink, small fluid teardrop noteheads, ornate French clefs, graceful S-curl and cursive rests, generous blank pre-ruled staves, and minimal bleed-through reflecting his recto-only writing habit.

ravel_microscopic_precision.name: ravel_microscopic_precision
ravel_microscopic_precision.description: Jewel-like, ultra-precise micro-calligraphy with tiny neat noteheads, ultra-fine steel nib, near-zero wobble, and crisp vertical stems.
ravel_microscopic_precision.paleography_notes: Modeled on Maurice Ravel's clockwork-like autograph scores and Stichvorlagen (e.g., Gaspard de la nuit, Daphnis et Chloe). Executed with an ultra-fine steel dip nib in crisp dark ink, producing tiny compact noteheads, almost completely vertical stems, negligible hand wobble or tremor, exact measured bar spacing, and clean geometric clefs on fine Parisian ivory paper.

stravinsky_stravigor_nib.name: stravinsky_stravigor_nib
stravinsky_stravigor_nib.description: High-contrast ruler-aided modernist score in bold black India ink with razor-sharp beams, crisp angular stems, and mechanical Stravigor staves.
stravinsky_stravigor_nib.paleography_notes: Modeled on Igor Stravinsky's iconic holographs prepared with his invented 5-wheel Stravigor roller-rastrum (c. 1911 onward) and straightedge-guided India ink calligraphy. Characterized by stark jet-black ink on clean ivory stock, mechanically straight uniform staves, bold chisel-angled strokes, heavy wedge noteheads, crisp upright angular stems, sharp geometric lightning-Z and tall-Z rests, and frequent rehearsal/instrumentation cues.

bartok_folk_field_notebook.name: bartok_folk_field_notebook
bartok_folk_field_notebook.description: Rapid ethnomusicological field transcription in HB graphite pencil on yellowed pocket paper with uneven bars, light grain, and cramped dense phrasing.
bartok_folk_field_notebook.paleography_notes: Modeled on Bela Bartok's rural Hungarian, Romanian, and Slovak folk-song field notebooks (Budapest Bartok Archives). Written on the spot in rapid HB pencil on small yellowed pocket paper with hand-drawn wavy staves, light graphite grain, compact crowded noteheads, severe bar-width variation and end-of-bar cramming, frequent erasures, and dense ethnographic margin annotations (cylinder numbers, village names, informant notes).

schoenberg_dense_atonal_ink.name: schoenberg_dense_atonal_ink
schoenberg_dense_atonal_ink.description: Intense dark-ink Viennese chamber manuscript with tall upright stems, heavy angular beams, tight irregular spacing, and crowded accidentals.
schoenberg_dense_atonal_ink.paleography_notes: Modeled on Arnold Schoenberg's intense atonal and twelve-tone chamber manuscripts (Arnold Schoenberg Center, Vienna). Uses heavy dark ink with strong pooling on aged Viennese paper, rigid tall upright stems (minimal slant), bold angled beams, compact noteheads tightly packed with irregular spacing and end-of-bar compression to accommodate dense chromatic accidentals, angular tall-Z and sharp-V rests, plus heavy analytical margin notes and Hauptstimme cues.

shostakovich_soviet_score_paper.name: shostakovich_soviet_score_paper
shostakovich_soviet_score_paper.description: Rapid, fluent blue-black fountain-pen score on slightly tinted Soviet pre-ruled paper with flowing right slant, hasty hooked rests, and wide sweeping bars.
shostakovich_soviet_score_paper.paleography_notes: Modeled on Dmitri Shostakovich's rapid symphonic and string-quartet manuscripts (Glinka Museum / Russian state archives). Penned fluently in blue-black fountain-pen ink on slightly cool-tinted Soviet Muzgiz pre-ruled score paper, featuring a strong forward right slant, brisk slash noteheads, signature hasty backwards-7 hooked rests, wide sweeping uncramped measures, generous ink flow with light bleed-through, and bold rehearsal-number annotations.
